title: SMS provider failover and NIN lookup outage cache (identity batch 3: ONA-ID-101, 203)

requirements.expectation: sendSms tries configured providers in SMS_PROVIDER_ORDER, returns the first success with the provider name, and reports every failed attempt. Unconfigured, unknown and repeated names are skipped; an invalid number fails without calling a provider; nothing sensitive is logged on failover.
evidence: code: src/lib/server/sms/__tests__/send.test.ts covers first-success, failover on a failed send, a provider that throws, all-fail reporting, number normalisation, invalid number, no provider, ordering rules, and that the failover log holds neither the number nor the code.

requirements.expectation: The Termii adapter is configured only when key, sender ID and base URL are all set, posts the documented body to {base}/api/sms/send, and treats a non-2xx reply, a reply without a message id, or a network error as failure.
requirements.verification: Unit test with a stubbed fetch.
evidence: code: send.test.ts 'real adapters' asserts the adapter stays off with only two of three variables, the exact request URL and JSON body, and the three failure cases.

requirements.expectation: Phone OTP is deliverable when any SMS provider is configured and a failed first provider still delivers through the second. Queued SMS notifications use the same path.
requirements.verification: Unit test through the real adapters with a stubbed fetch; OTP route test; diff inspection of notifications-retry.ts.
evidence: code: send.test.ts asserts that with the first adapter's API returning 503 the message is delivered by termii and the attempt list names africastalking.
code: src/app/api/auth/otp/send/__tests__/route.test.ts now drives the route through isSmsConfigured/sendSms (8 cases pass).
code: src/lib/server/notifications-retry.ts calls sendSms; it has no test of its own.

requirements.expectation: A live NIN confirmation is cached. During a provider outage (network error, 408, 429, 5xx) an unexpired entry is returned with cached:true; a miss or an expired entry returns the outage. A rejection, a missing key and auth or billing errors never use the cache. The stored lookup record carries the cached marker.
evidence: code: src/lib/server/identity/__tests__/nin-cache.test.ts covers write on live confirmation, cached fallback, miss, expiry, the five outage codes, the four non-outage codes, and format-only or already-cached results not being stored.
code: src/lib/server/identity/__tests__/id-lookup.test.ts asserts the record's cached flag.

requirements.expectation: The cache key is an HMAC of the number; neither the key nor the stored value contains the number (or the phone the provider returns); entries carry expires_at; with no secret the cache is off; a broken cache store never breaks a lookup.
evidence: code: nin-cache.test.ts asserts the key shape, that it changes with the secret, the exact stored row (no number, no phone, 30-day expiry), cache off without a secret, and normal answers when the store throws or the database is not configured.

requirements.expectation: supabase/migrations/20261113_084_id_lookup_cache.sql creates id_lookup_cache with key_hash primary key, expires_at index, RLS enabled and forced, and all access revoked from anon and authenticated.
requirements.verification: File inspection. The migration has not been executed anywhere.
evidence: code: file follows the 064 idempotent_ops pattern (enable + force RLS, revoke from anon/authenticated, grant to service_role/postgres) and the next free number, 084.
code: not run against a database; SQL validity is unverified beyond reading it.

requirements.expectation: The full local check suite passes.
requirements.verification: npm test, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run check:server-boundaries, npm run check:openapi-drift.
evidence: code: 227 Vitest files (2,048 tests) pass; eslint 0 errors (143 warnings, none introduced); tsc --noEmit exits 0; check:server-boundaries verified; check:openapi-drift ok.

requirements.expectation: With both SMS providers set, an OTP arrives through the second when the first is disabled. With migration 084 applied, a NIN checked once is served from the cache during a simulated provider outage.
requirements.verification: Live QA on the hosted environment.

code: No circuit breaker: during an outage every send still tries the first provider first.
Delivery receipts are not read, so a provider that accepts but never delivers counts as a success.
src/app/api/security/action/route.ts and the contact-change flow do not use the failover.
notifications-retry.ts has no test covering its SMS branch.
external: Apply migration 084 on the target Supabase; until then the cache is silently off.
Create the Termii account, get a sender ID approved, and set TERMII_API_KEY, TERMII_SENDER_ID and TERMII_BASE_URL on the host.
Verify the Termii adapter against the live API; it was written from the public documentation only.
Optionally set ID_LOOKUP_CACHE_SECRET so the cache key does not depend on the service-role key (rotating that key empties the cache).
Merge batch 1 and batch 2 first; this branch is stacked on them.
Independent human review against the implementation commit.
